Third-party files used only by the Format Atlas page (/en/convert, /ar/convert). They are loaded on demand,
from this site, when someone opens a PDF. Nothing is fetched from another server.

pdfjs/     PDF.js 5.6.205 legacy build (Mozilla, Apache-2.0)   https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js   (rendering, text, thumbnails)
pdf-lib/   pdf-lib 1.17.1 (Andrew Dillon, MIT)    https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib  (merge, split, rotate, clean metadata)

To update, replace the files with a newer build and keep the same file names.
